method: Independent model review of all eleven proposed lexical templates and all 176 exact source combined-form senses, read individually in two 88-record batches. Selected exact English root sense/hash and checked argument roles, explicit source glosses, accusative object gender/number, source lemma references and imperative/infinitive metadata. Approved records select a transparent inanimate it/them reading; not universal translations of every possible referent. Only explicit lo/la/los/las, positive imperative or infinitive are authorized. No spelling/suffix decomposition, se/reflexive, dative or ambiguous first/second-person objects, multiple clitics, negative clauses or other finite moods. Third-person grammatical affirmative imperatives are formal address commands, not third-person declarative subjects. All source usage labels remain required. No fabricated examples or native-human certification, application edits, source publication, or derived coverage claim.
